subject.title: fix(test): unit tests fail on built checkouts and live host configs while CI stays green

question: Should this branch be narrowed to the unit-fast/test-discovery repair before merge, or should maintainers sponsor the unrelated app/protocol changes as part of this PR?
rationale: The protected maintainer label, dirty merge state, and unrelated product/protocol surface mean automation cannot safely infer the intended branch shape.

options.title: Narrow to test infrastructure
options.body: Keep only the hermetic test setup repair, fix the two unit-fast blockers, and rebase before normal review.

options.title: Sponsor the broader branch
options.body: Treat the app, gateway protocol, docs, and extension changes as intentional and require a full product/security/upgrade review before merge.

options.title: Split or replace the PR
options.body: Close or supersede this branch after preserving the test fix in a clean PR and moving unrelated changes to dedicated branches.
